post.description:
Organizer only (AUTHZ-1). Publishes the transcript: a new revision and its outbox job commit together, and
the text becomes searchable once the worker has indexed it (TRANSCRIPT-1, DATA-1).

Organizer only (AUTHZ-1). Takes the transcript back to processing, as a correction does: a new revision whose
projection removes every chunk from search, and no older job can bring them back (DATA-1).

Where should I go next? Talks that haven't started, that pass the persona's hard rules, ranked by her stated
interests and history, each with checkable reasons and the published access facts. The persona comes from
X-Demo-Profile-ID (AUTHZ-1); nothing she typed or set is logged (PRIV-1).

parameters.description: The demo persona the request acts as. The server looks her up and trusts nothing else the client says about her (AUTHZ-1).
parameters.name: X-Demo-Profile-ID

400.description: No persona chosen: X-Demo-Profile-ID is missing or empty

404.description: No selectable persona has that ID

503.description: Suggestions aren't available right now: the event's schedule isn't imported, search isn't configured, or retrieval failed

post.description: Which talks match what I'm interested in? The query arrives in the body, never in the URL (PRIV-1).

get.description: The captioned replay of a concluded session, with its transcript only once published (TRANSCRIPT-1).
The process is running. Never calls PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch or OpenAI (K8S-1).
The process can take traffic. Downstream outages show up as explicit errors, not as unready pods (K8S-1).
